title: Decent.
text: First, a very good value for what you pay versus what you get. Usually two full size products and the rest are travel size.  For that alone, it's a very good deal.  Second, the variety has been good. No repeats on brands.  Third, it seems to be more skin care focus but any make up that has come have been universally flattering items, like black mascara or a rose nude lipstick.  Going through Amazon allows you to skip a month if you want which is nice. Overall, I've been very happy with it and it's allowed me to try some things I have been curious about and not have to pay full price to see if they work for me or not and if they didn't, I don't feel bad tossing it.
label: positive
